# P027 SpaceGhostKilla consulting-readiness evidence gate

This packet turns the eight global owner decisions in the existing native
consulting pack into one strict, public-safe status record. It does not approve
outside work, select an offer, review terms, create a secure evidence channel,
open an account, host a commercial funnel, send an inquiry, authorize a client
engagement or release a product.

The source remains `jordanistan/spaceghostkilla`, pinned to commit
`57e38f934a6ab5feedb7e855ac4472966af895cd`. That commit contains the existing
blank consulting templates and the P025 live verifier. Update the pin only after
a reviewed native change.

## Global readiness order

1. Privately review applicable outside-work, confidentiality and conflict
   boundaries. Use no employer accounts, equipment or confidential information.
2. With owner or administrator access, verify applicable MFA, secret scanning,
   push protection and branch rules.
3. Approve one Entra identity **or** one CI/CD evidence-review boundary,
   deliverables, exclusions, revisions and genuine capacity.
4. Approve the quote process after reviewing effort and costs. This does not
   approve a final client fee.
5. Obtain appropriate review and approve the private commercial-terms framework.
   This does not execute a client agreement.
6. Verify the restricted evidence transfer, storage, readers, tools, incident
   contact and retention or deletion controls.
7. Verify the owner-controlled invoicing, payment, payout and refund process
   privately. This does not issue an invoice or prove settlement.
8. Verify authenticated commercial staging, HTTPS and response headers, both
   preserved free downloads, and one harmless inquiry receipt/reply test before
   any reviewed cutover.

The validator enforces dependency and timestamp chronology. A verified gate is
still a public owner attestation, not proof that the reviewer, account, channel,
agreement, inbox or private evidence exists.

## Per-engagement authorization remains separate

P027 never evaluates or authorizes a real engagement. Before each engagement,
privately verify client authority and asset control, written approved activities
and time window, applicable third-party permissions, and a stop/revocation path.
Payment alone is not authorization. Direct access stays excluded by default and
requires a separate least-privilege, time-limited written boundary.

## Public/private boundary

GitHub may contain only the fixed gate state, allowed reviewer-role label,
timestamp, boolean private-evidence marker and fixed neutral note. Never commit
employment records, client identity, system or tenant identifiers, evidence,
credentials, legal advice, executed terms, private quotes, invoice or processor
records, bank or tax data, inbox contents, access details or private evidence
references.

Even when all eight global gates are verified, P027 permanently keeps commercial
launch, outreach, engagement, system access, invoice issuance, payment receipt,
customer acquisition, revenue and Field Manual/KubeScan release false. Each of
those requires separate real evidence and authorization.

## Validation

```bash
python3 -m unittest portfolio.test_spaceghostkilla_consulting -v
python3 portfolio/spaceghostkilla_consulting.py
```

Start from `P027_CONSULTING_EVIDENCE_TEMPLATE.json` only after reviewing the
matching private evidence. Publish only the sanitized status shape accepted by
the validator.
